title: What beauty buyers from UK retailers Boots and Lookfantastic are looking for in 2027
summary: The brains behind some of the UK’s biggest beauty retailers reveal what they are looking for when onboarding new brands in 2027, covering the trends, categories, ingredients and formats they will be investing in
